title: Joel's Prophecy about the Outpouring of the Spirit
description: The prophet Joel proclaims that God will pour out his Spirit on all people, so that sons and daughters will prophesy, old men will have dreams, and young men will see visions. Signs in the sky and on earth will precede the great day of the Lord, and everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
